name: karl-chat-worker
description: Chat endpoint for the 'Ask about my experience' widget on karlkiser.com. Deployed separately from the site (which is static on GitHub Pages).

scripts.logs: wrangler d1 execute chat-logs --remote --command "SELECT cid, datetime(MIN(created_at)/1000,'unixepoch') AS started, COUNT(*) AS turns, country FROM turns GROUP BY cid ORDER BY MIN(created_at) DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.logs:local: wrangler d1 execute chat-logs --local --command "SELECT turn_index, status, user_text, reply_text FROM turns ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20"
